name: join referential data so project members map to employees
definition: resolve project member references against the employee set within the same department so every referenced member id resolves.
failure_mode: orphan member ids failing to resolve causes referential-integrity assertions to fail

name: keep parallel contigs equal to the serial result
definition: the pieces of the graph outputs must be identical to the fragment set assembled by the serial version, where rank order may vary across ranks.
failure_mode: a partitioning/traversal bug yields different contigs and breaks equality
